title: Add the three lore context profiles to .lore/agents
description: This repository's .lore/agents directory is empty while opum-doc, quest-cli and opum-cli-e2e each carry implementation, review and verification profiles. A subagent working here therefore has no budgeted, provenance-stamped evidence pack to ground in and falls back to crawling seventy-six concepts. Add the same three, with sources chosen per role rather than copied, and with max_tokens measured against this bundle rather than inherited from a much smaller one. Requested by opum-agent under OPAG-33 as part of the Claude Code greenfield cutover.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore agent list returns implementation, review and verification
A real pack compiles for each profile and is read
No source scoring 9 or above is marked omitted-by-budget in any of the three packs

implementationNotes: Root cause of the empty directory, which the cutover plan recorded as a symptom without a cause: .lore/agents/ was gitignored in this repository and in no other. opum-doc, quest-cli and opum-cli-e2e each commit three profiles; here the directory could never hold one. The ignore carried the comment 'generated by lore agents', which conflates two different commands one letter apart — 'lore agents' regenerates the skill bridges (SKILL.md and the CLAUDE.md nudge), while 'lore agent' compiles and lists context profiles and generates nothing. A profile authored under that ignore would have been machine-local, invisible in review, and lost with the working copy: the same failure class as a gitignored tracker.

Verified after landing: git ls-files .lore/agents/ returns all three .toml files, so they are genuinely tracked and not merely present on disk — which is the fact this task exists to establish. All nine required checks passed on the PR SHA, including the operating block digest.
finalSummary: Added implementation, review and verification context profiles, and removed the .gitignore entry that made them impossible to commit. The empty directory was never an authoring gap: .lore/agents/ was ignored here and in no other fleet repository, on a comment that credited 'lore agents' with generating it. That command regenerates the skill bridges; 'lore agent' is the profile command and generates nothing. Sources are chosen per role rather than copied from opum-doc, and budgets were measured against this bundle rather than inherited — at opum-doc's 10-12k, adr/0014-core-has-no-llm-dependency came back 0/8 selected at score 9.79, so a sweep from 10k to 24k set implementation at 20000, review at 18000 and verification at 16000, where no source scoring 9 or above is omitted. lore check: 76 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Landed as PR #561, squash-merged into dev with all nine required checks green. LCLI-432 files the gap this exposed: lore agent context has no --workspace flag, so a profile cannot compile a cross-repository pack.
